name: METR task-completion time horizon
what_it_measures: How long a task, timed by how long a skilled person takes, an AI agent can finish with 50% success. METR fits a doubling time to it.
source: METR, Time Horizons of Frontier AI Models
licence: No open licence stated (site: all rights reserved)
licence_note: robots.txt allows the download, but no licence grants reuse of the per-model numbers. Only METR's headline doubling times are quoted here, with attribution; the chart lives on METR's page. Decision pending: store per-model numbers, or ask METR.
citation: METR, 'Task-Completion Time Horizons of Frontier AI Models', https://metr.org/time-horizons/
changes: Only METR's own fitted doubling times are quoted, with their ranges, from the YAML files it publishes; per-model numbers are not stored unless METR_STORE_ROWS=1. Coverage notes are ours.

coverage.summary: 26 models in v1.1, 2019-02-14 to 2026-04-07: OpenAI 15, Anthropic 9, Google DeepMind 2. The tasks are software and ML-research work only, so this is not general capability. METR may skip a release or measure it late.
coverage.counted: Models METR has run on its task suite, mostly from OpenAI, Anthropic and Google, plus old baselines.
coverage.not_counted: In v1.1: no models from xAI, Meta AI, DeepSeek, Alibaba, Moonshot, Mistral AI. (xAI, DeepSeek, Alibaba, Moonshot appear only in an older version.)

quoted.note: METR excludes points whose central 50% horizon is over 16 hours
